verdict.rationale: LibreChat is built around AI agents. Users create them in the Agent Builder side panel, select them from a dropdown or with an @ mention in chat, and give them tools, code interpretation, file handling, API actions, MCP servers, Skills and subagents to carry out delegated tasks. This is described as a no-code, GPTs-like framework. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven task delegation (community evidence only praises plugin/function support generally), and evidence of an out-of-the-box assistant that works without the user configuring agents and model providers.
